attribution.localizedCause: LibNC computes each 32-stream BF16 matrix-gradient dot from zero with sequential fused FMAs, adds the decoded prior BF16 gradient only after the dot, and then materializes BF16 once at the state boundary; initializing the FMA accumulator from the prior changes 43 words.

decision.rationale: Freeze an immutable post-dot-add successor, require exact treatment plus reverse and sign controls under that cell, and only then expand the uniform open kernel beyond the 128-row slice.

hypothesis.rationale: The frozen prior-initialized FMA treatment missed 43 of 131,072 words, whereas the prospectively declared post-dot prior-add cell matched the complete LibNC treatment slice with zero error.

retiredDimensions: Prior-initialized FMA and nonfused multiply/add as source-exact within-state FF1 matrix-gradient kernels
transferableLessons: For FF1 matrix gradients, graph-state materialization is shared with bias gradients but the within-state update differs: dot first, prior gradient second, BF16 conversion last.

reasons: The revision-bound open grid completed two byte-identical five-cell populations, every strict output and source/dependency/resource guard passed, and all comparisons used the frozen independent LibNC slices.
